text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- An international jury selected Maarja-Liis Ilus, last year's Estonian singer at the Eurovision song contest, to represent Estonia for the second time.
- Estonian sisters Kristiina and Katrin Smigun came first and second at the juniors' World Cup skiing competition in Canada in the 15 kilometre race.
- Negotiations over the forming of the new cabinet will continue.
- Foreign Minister Toomas Hendrik Ilves hopes to win German support to Estonia during his visit to begin tomorrow.
- Jakob von Uexkull to present last Estonian Renaissance Awards today.
- Doctors are concerned with the loss of weight among schoolchildren.
- The Estonian consulate general in St.Petersburg is still closed because of a power shortage. A new visa office is to be opened in March or April.
- An IMF delegation ended its visit to Estonia. The government should control local spending and hasten the pace of pension reform, the delegation said.
- Estonian advertising market grew 45 percent last year to 409 million kroons.
